reasons.text: The duplicate check found another claim (515695d6-3014-5417-84ae-7b3768c30c0b) sharing the same payout destination. Claims sharing a payout account must go to a person for review.
The label photo is legible and shows LSE4611BD, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The serial number 409KM8955161 falls outside the recalled serial ranges. This would be a denial on its own, and the reviewer should weigh it alongside the duplicate match.

The retailer (The Home Depot) is on the list and the purchase date of 2014-07-24 is before the sale window (2015-01-01 to 2025-01-31), so the purchase would be denied on its own. No destruction photo is required under this remedy.
